title: Core spine: service registry, contact identity, session auth, i18n
delivered: defineService wrapper: permission → validation → transaction → audit-in-tx → post-commit bus
Service composition via ctx.call / ctx.callAsSystem, sharing one transaction
Contact spine with a unique-email identity rule, contacts.resolve and contacts.merge
Owner registration guaranteed once by a partial unique index; token-scoped logout
i18n string layer with BCP-47 fallback chain and per-currency minor units
Boot sequence: core manifest, topo-sorted wiring, service registration and listener subscription, entered from instrumentation.ts
Production environment asserted at boot rather than at first login
Service-layer gate (§15.5) extended to the Drizzle client and driver
Type-aware lint, with the money gate (§15.4) expressed as lint rules
License-header gate enforcing the AGPL/MIT boundary in CI
Test harness: TEST_DATABASE_URL isolation, migrations in globalSetup, 92 tests
openFollowUps: contacts.resolve never updates an existing contact: a returning form submission's new phone/locale/source is silently discarded (§4.6 names contact_create/update)
contacts.merge orphans the duplicate's users row when both contacts have a login
No expired-session sweep: rows are deleted only when revisited, revoked, or cascaded (needs core/jobs)
Post-commit event bus is in-process, so events are lost if the process dies mid-publish
updatedAt is hand-maintained in contacts.update only; other write paths will drift
TimelineEventInput.subjectId is typed string against a uuid column
tests/helpers/spine.ts hand-lists spine tables while src/core/tables.ts is the barrel — they will drift
License-header gate does not cover CSS (needs block-comment handling)
Boot mounts no routes, jobs or MCP tools — no such surfaces exist yet
The FX-inside-charge-paths half of the money gate (§15.4) awaits an fx adapter

title: The HTTP edge: actor resolution, service routes, auth endpoints
delivered: src/core/http: cookies, actor resolution, ServiceError-to-status mapping, serviceRoute wrapper
Framework-agnostic (web Request/Response) so src/ stays free of Next imports
Session token lives only in an HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie, never in a response body
Sliding session renewal re-issues the cookie so the browser copy cannot expire first
Verified end to end over real HTTP against the dev database, not only as function calls
openFollowUps: No CSRF defence beyond SameSite=Lax; state-changing routes need a token before browser forms post with cookie auth
No rate limiting on login or setup — brute force is currently unbounded
No middleware yet for locale routing or noindex headers on /admin and /portal
Cookie is re-issued only by GET /api/auth/session; other routes let it drift toward expiry
